# Pull Request Record

## Purpose

Describe the user or engineering outcome this change should produce.

## Scope and non-goals

List the included scope and what this PR intentionally does not change.

## Validation evidence

List commands, environments, versions, and evidence for the current head SHA.

## Release impact

Describe the release path, runtime impact, or why no runtime release is needed.

## Recovery plan

Describe how to stop, revert, roll back, or safely forward-fix this change.

## Related records

Link the requirement, design, change, release, incident, or retrospective records.

## Independent review

Required for medium/high risk. Identify the reviewer or pending review boundary.

## Integration/system evidence

Required for medium/high risk. Link evidence covering affected system boundaries.

## Design record

Required for high risk. Link the approved design and recorded tradeoffs.

## Specialist review

Required for high risk. Link security, privacy, compliance, architecture, or other applicable expert review.

## Data recovery

Required for high risk. Describe migration invariants and data recovery or forward-repair evidence.

## Human Go/No-Go owner

Required for high risk. Name the authorized human responsible for the final production decision.
